using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Text;
using static Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.Theme;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Master Detail ComboBox", width: 760, height: 480);

class App : Component
{
    private static readonly string[] Items =
    [
        "Overview",
        "Usage",
        "Billing",
        "Settings"
    ];

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (selectedItem, setSelectedItem) = UseState(Items[0]);
        var selectedIndex = Array.IndexOf(Items, selectedItem);

        return Border(
            Grid(

                rows: ["Auto", "*"],

                    .Background(CardBackground)
                    .WithBorder(CardStroke)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Grid(row: 1, column: 0),
                Border(
                    VStack(12,
                        TextBlock("Detail").FontWeight(FontWeights.SemiBold),
                        TextBlock($"Selected section: {selectedItem}")
                            .Foreground(SecondaryText)
                            .TextWrapping()))

                    .Padding(16)
                    .Grid(row: 1, column: 1))
                .ColumnSpacing(16)
                .RowSpacing(16))
            .Background(SolidBackground)
            .Padding(24)
            .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default);
    }
}

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Tabbed Filter App", width: 900, height: 600);

class App : Component
{
    private static readonly string[] Items =
    [
        "Apple",
        "Apricot",
        "Banana",
        "Blackberry",
        "Blueberry",
        "Cherry",
        "Grape",
        "Grapefruit",
        "Lemon",
        "Lime",
        "Mango",
        "Orange",
        "Peach",
        "Pear",
        "Pineapple",
        "Plum",
        "Raspberry",
        "Strawberry",
        "Watermelon"
    ];

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (filter, setFilter) = UseState("");
        var filteredItems = Items
            .Where(item => item.Contains(filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .ToArray();

        return TabView(
            Tab("Filtered", FilteredItemsTab(filter, setFilter, filteredItems)),
            Tab("All strings", ItemsList(Items))
        )
        .ShowAddButton(false)
        .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default);
    }

    private static Element FilteredItemsTab(string filter, Action<string> setFilter, IReadOnlyList<string> filteredItems) =>
        Grid(["*"], ["Auto", "*"],
            [
                TextField(filter, setFilter, placeholder: "Type to filter strings", header: "Filter")
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 0)
                    .Margin(0, 0, 0, 12),

                Border(
                    filteredItems.Count == 0
                        ? TextBlock("No strings match the current filter.")
                            .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                            .Padding(12)
                        : ItemsList(filteredItems)
                )
                .Grid(row: 1, column: 0)
                .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
                .CornerRadius(8)
            ])
            .Padding(24);

    private static Element ItemsList(IReadOnlyList<string> items) =>
        ListView(items, item => item, (item, _) =>
            TextBlock(item)
                .Padding(12, 8))
        .SelectionMode(ListViewSelectionMode.None);
}

before.text:
using Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Layout;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Slider Counter", width: 420, height: 320);

class App : Component
{
    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (counter, setCounter) = UseState(50);
        var (isDialogOpen, setDialogOpen) = UseState(false);

        return Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto(), GridSize.Auto(), GridSize.Star(), GridSize.Auto()],
            TextBlock("Slider Counter")
                .FontSize(28)
                .SemiBold()
                .Grid(0, 0),

            TextBlock($"Current value: {counter}")
                .FontSize(18)
                .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                .Grid(1, 0),

            Border(
                Grid(
                    columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                    rows: [GridSize.Auto(), GridSize.Auto()],
                    TextBlock(counter.ToString())
                        .FontSize(56)
                        .SemiBold()
                        .Grid(0, 0),
                    TextBlock("Open the dialog to adjust the bound counter.")
                        .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                        .Grid(1, 0)
                )
                .Padding(24)
            )
            .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
            .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
            .CornerRadius(16)
            .Grid(2, 0),

            Button("Adjust counter", () => setDialogOpen(true))
                .Grid(3, 0),

            ContentDialog(
                "Adjust counter",
                Grid(
                    columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                    rows: [GridSize.Auto(), GridSize.Auto()],
                    TextBlock($"Counter: {counter}")
                        .FontSize(20)
                        .SemiBold()
                        .Grid(0, 0),
                    (Slider(counter, 0, 100, value => setCounter((int)Math.Round(value))) with
                    {
                        Header = "Counter",
                        StepFrequency = 1,
                    })
                    .Grid(1, 0)
                ),
                primaryButtonText: "Done") with
            {
                IsOpen = isDialogOpen,
                OnClosed = _ => setDialogOpen(false),
            }
        )
        .Padding(24)
        .Background(Theme.SolidBackground);
    }
}

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Tabbed Filter Counter", width: 900, height: 600);

class App : Component
{
    private static readonly string[] FilterOptions = ["All", "Even", "Odd", "Multiples of 3"];
    private static readonly IReadOnlyList<int> Numbers = Enumerable.Range(1, 30).ToArray();

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter) = UseState(0);
        var (counter, setCounter) = UseState(0);

        var filteredNumbers = Numbers
            .Where(number => MatchesFilter(number, selectedFilter))
            .ToArray();

        return Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
            Heading("Tabbed filter counter")
                .Margin(24, 24, 24, 8)
                .Grid(row: 0),
            TabView(
                Tab("Counter",
                    Grid(
                        columns: [GridSize.Star(), GridSize.Px(220)],
                        rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
                        ComboBox(FilterOptions, selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter)
                            .Header("Filter numbers")
                            .MinWidth(220)
                            .Grid(row: 0, column: 0),
                        CounterCard(counter, setCounter)
                            .Grid(row: 0, column: 1),
                        NumberList(filteredNumbers)
                            .Grid(row: 1, column: 0, columnSpan: 2))
                    .Padding(24)),
                Tab("Summary",
                    Grid(
                        columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                        rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto],
                        SubHeading("Current selection").Grid(row: 0),
                        TextBlock($"Filter: {FilterOptions[selectedFilter]}")
                            .Margin(0, 12, 0, 0)
                            .Grid(row: 1),
                        TextBlock($"Counter: {counter}")
                            .Margin(0, 8, 0, 0)
                            .Grid(row: 2))
                    .Padding(24)))
            .ShowAddButton(false)
            .Grid(row: 1))
        .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default)
        .Background(Theme.SolidBackground);
    }

    private static bool MatchesFilter(int number, int selectedFilter) => selectedFilter switch
    {
        1 => number % 2 == 0,
        2 => number % 2 != 0,
        3 => number % 3 == 0,
        _ => true,
    };

    private static Element CounterCard(int counter, Action<int> setCounter) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto],
                Caption("Counter").Grid(row: 0),
                Heading(counter.ToString())
                    .Margin(0, 4, 0, 12)
                    .Grid(row: 1),
                HStack(8,
                    Button("Decrease", () => setCounter(counter - 1)),
                    Button("Increase", () => setCounter(counter + 1)))
                .Grid(row: 2)))
        .Padding(16)
        .Margin(16, 0, 0, 16)
        .CornerRadius(8)
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke);

    private static Element NumberList(IReadOnlyList<int> numbers) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star],
                TextBlock($"{numbers.Count} numbers")
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Margin(12)
                    .Grid(row: 0),
                ListView<int>(
                    numbers,
                    keySelector: number => number.ToString(),
                    viewBuilder: (number, _) => Grid(
                        columns: [GridSize.Px(64), GridSize.Star()],
                        rows: [GridSize.Auto],
                        TextBlock(number.ToString()).Grid(row: 0, column: 0),
                        TextBlock(NumberDescription(number))
                            .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                            .Grid(row: 0, column: 1))
                    .Padding(12))
                .Grid(row: 1)))
        .CornerRadius(8)
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke);

    private static string NumberDescription(int number) =>
        number % 2 == 0 ? "Even integer" : "Odd integer";
}

using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Master Detail Toggle", width: 920, height: 620);

enum DetailAction
{
    Inspect,
    Approve,
    Archive
}

sealed record WorkItem(
    string Id,
    string Title,
    string Owner,
    string Status,
    string Summary);

sealed record AppState(
    string SelectedItemId,
    DetailAction SelectedAction,
    bool ActionToggle,
    string LastAction)
{
    public static AppState Initial =>
        new("REQ-101", DetailAction.Inspect, false, "Choose an enum action, then use the toggle to run it.");
}

sealed class App : Component
{
    private static readonly IReadOnlyList<WorkItem> Items =
    [
        new("REQ-101", "New vendor review", "Maya Chen", "Ready", "Review vendor risk details before approval."),
        new("REQ-204", "Access renewal", "Ari Patel", "In progress", "Confirm the access renewal request and archive it when complete."),
        new("REQ-319", "Deployment window", "Sam Rivera", "Waiting", "Inspect the proposed deployment window and approve the final schedule.")
    ];

    private static readonly string[] ActionNames = Enum.GetNames<DetailAction>();

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (state, setState) = UseState(AppState.Initial);
        var selectedItem = Items.First(item => item.Id == state.SelectedItemId);

        void SelectItem(WorkItem item) =>
            setState(state with
            {
                SelectedItemId = item.Id,
                LastAction = $"Selected {item.Title}."
            });

        void SelectAction(int index) =>
            setState(state with
            {
                SelectedAction = (DetailAction)index,
                LastAction = $"{ActionLabel((DetailAction)index)} is ready for {selectedItem.Title}."
            });

        void TriggerAction(bool isOn) =>
            setState(state with
            {
                ActionToggle = isOn,
                LastAction = $"{ActionLabel(state.SelectedAction)} triggered for {selectedItem.Title}."
            });

        return Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
            (TitleBar("Master Detail Toggle") with
            {
                Subtitle = "A toggle triggers the selected enum action."
            })
                .Grid(row: 0),
            (Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Px(280), GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Star()],
                MasterPane(state.SelectedItemId, SelectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 0),
                DetailPane(selectedItem, state, SelectAction, TriggerAction)
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 1)) with
            {
                ColumnSpacing = 16
            })
                .Padding(24)
                .Grid(row: 1))
            .Background(Theme.SolidBackground)
            .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default);
    }

    private static Element MasterPane(string selectedItemId, Action<WorkItem> selectItem) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
                SubHeading("Master")
                    .Grid(row: 0),
                Caption("Select a request")
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 1),
                ItemButton(Items[0], selectedItemId, selectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 2),
                ItemButton(Items[1], selectedItemId, selectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 3),
                ItemButton(Items[2], selectedItemId, selectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 4)) with
            {
                RowSpacing = 12
            })
        .Padding(16)
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
        .CornerRadius(12);

    private static Element ItemButton(WorkItem item, string selectedItemId, Action<WorkItem> selectItem) =>
        Button($"{item.Id}  {item.Title}", () => selectItem(item))
            .HorizontalAlignment(HorizontalAlignment.Stretch)
            .Foreground(item.Id == selectedItemId ? Theme.PrimaryText : Theme.SecondaryText);

    private static Element DetailPane(
        WorkItem item,
        AppState state,
        Action<int> selectAction,
        Action<bool> triggerAction) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
                Heading(item.Title)
                    .Grid(row: 0),
                Caption($"{item.Id} | {item.Owner} | {item.Status}")
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 1),
                TextBlock(item.Summary)
                    .TextWrapping()
                    .Grid(row: 2),
                ComboBox(ActionNames, (int)state.SelectedAction, selectAction)
                    .Header("Enum action")
                    .Grid(row: 3),
                ToggleSwitch(
                    state.ActionToggle,
                    triggerAction,
                    onContent: "Action triggered",
                    offContent: "Ready to trigger",
                    header: "Trigger selected action")
                    .Grid(row: 4),
                Border(
                    TextBlock(state.LastAction)
                        .TextWrapping()
                        .SemiBold())
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Background(Theme.SolidBackground)
                    .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Grid(row: 5)) with
            {
                RowSpacing = 14
            })
        .Padding(20)
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
        .CornerRadius(12)
        .Margin(16, 0, 0, 0);

    private static string ActionLabel(DetailAction action) => action switch
    {
        DetailAction.Inspect => "Inspect",
        DetailAction.Approve => "Approve",
        DetailAction.Archive => "Archive",
        _ => action.ToString()
    };
}

sealed record AppState(
    string SelectedItemId,
    DetailAction SelectedAction,
    bool ActionToggle,
    string LastAction)
{
    public static AppState Initial =>
        new("REQ-101", DetailAction.Inspect, false, "Choose an enum action, then use the toggle to run it.");
}

sealed class App : Component
{
    private static readonly IReadOnlyList<WorkItem> Items =
    [
        new("REQ-101", "New vendor review", "Maya Chen", "Ready", "Review vendor risk details before approval."),
        new("REQ-204", "Access renewal", "Ari Patel", "In progress", "Confirm the access renewal request and archive it when complete."),
        new("REQ-319", "Deployment window", "Sam Rivera", "Waiting", "Inspect the proposed deployment window and approve the final schedule.")
    ];

    private static readonly string[] ActionNames = Enum.GetNames<DetailAction>();

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (state, setState) = UseState(AppState.Initial);
        var selectedItem = Items.First(item => item.Id == state.SelectedItemId);

        void SelectItem(WorkItem item) =>
            setState(state with
            {
                SelectedItemId = item.Id,
                LastAction = $"Selected {item.Title}."
            });

        void SelectAction(int index) =>
            setState(state with
            {
                SelectedAction = (DetailAction)index,
                LastAction = $"{ActionLabel((DetailAction)index)} is ready for {selectedItem.Title}."
            });

        void TriggerAction(bool isOn) =>
            setState(state with
            {
                ActionToggle = isOn,
                LastAction = $"{ActionLabel(state.SelectedAction)} triggered for {selectedItem.Title}."
            });

        return Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
            (TitleBar("Master Detail Toggle") with
            {
                Subtitle = "A toggle triggers the selected enum action."
            })
                .Grid(row: 0),
            (Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Px(280), GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Star()],
                MasterPane(state.SelectedItemId, SelectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 0),
                DetailPane(selectedItem, state, SelectAction, TriggerAction)
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 1)) with
            {
                ColumnSpacing = 16
            })
                .Padding(24)
                .Grid(row: 1))
            .Background(Theme.SolidBackground)
            .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default);
    }

    private static Element MasterPane(string selectedItemId, Action<WorkItem> selectItem) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
                SubHeading("Master")
                    .Grid(row: 0),
                Caption("Select a request")
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 1),
                ItemButton(Items[0], selectedItemId, selectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 2),
                ItemButton(Items[1], selectedItemId, selectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 3),
                ItemButton(Items[2], selectedItemId, selectItem)
                    .Grid(row: 4)) with
            {
                RowSpacing = 12
            })
        .Padding(16)
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
        .CornerRadius(12);

    private static Element ItemButton(WorkItem item, string selectedItemId, Action<WorkItem> selectItem) =>
        Button($"{item.Id}  {item.Title}", () => selectItem(item))
            .HAlign(HorizontalAlignment.Stretch)
            .Foreground(item.Id == selectedItemId ? Theme.PrimaryText : Theme.SecondaryText)
            .AutomationName($"Select {item.Title}");

    private static Element DetailPane(
        WorkItem item,
        AppState state,
        Action<int> selectAction,
        Action<bool> triggerAction) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
                Heading(item.Title)
                    .Grid(row: 0),
                Caption($"{item.Id} | {item.Owner} | {item.Status}")
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 1),
                TextBlock(item.Summary)
                    .TextWrapping()
                    .Grid(row: 2),
                ComboBox(ActionNames, (int)state.SelectedAction, selectAction)
                    .Header("Enum action")
                    .Grid(row: 3),
                ToggleSwitch(
                    state.ActionToggle,
                    triggerAction,
                    onContent: "Action triggered",
                    offContent: "Ready to trigger",
                    header: "Trigger selected action")
                    .Grid(row: 4),
                Border(
                    TextBlock(state.LastAction)
                        .TextWrapping()
                        .SemiBold())
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Background(Theme.SolidBackground)
                    .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Grid(row: 5)) with
            {
                RowSpacing = 14
            })
        .Padding(20)
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
        .CornerRadius(12)
        .Margin(16, 0, 0, 0);

    private static string ActionLabel(DetailAction action) => action switch
    {
        DetailAction.Inspect => "Inspect",
        DetailAction.Approve => "Approve",
        DetailAction.Archive => "Archive",
        _ => action.ToString()
    };
}

                        .Select(WorkItemRow)

    static Element WorkItemRow(WorkItem item)
        => Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Star(), GridSize.Px(120)],

                TextBlock(item.Title)
                    .SemiBold()
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 0),

                Caption(item.Details)
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 1, column: 0)
                    .Margin(0, 4, 0, 0),

                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 1, rowSpan: 2)
                    .HAlign(HorizontalAlignment.Right)

            .Background(Theme.CardBackground)

            .Padding(16)
            .WithKey(item.Id);

    static string FormatPriority(WorkPriority priority)
        => priority switch
        {
            WorkPriority.Low => "Low",
            WorkPriority.Medium => "Medium",
            WorkPriority.High => "High",
            _ => priority.ToString(),
        };
}

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Tabbed enum filter", width: 900, height: 600);

enum WorkKind
{
    All,
    Design,
    Implementation,
    Testing,
    Documentation
}

record WorkItem(string Title, WorkKind Kind, string Description);

class App : Component
{
    static readonly WorkItem[] Items =
    [
        new("Sketch app shell", WorkKind.Design, "Define the tabs and grid layout."),
        new("Build filter control", WorkKind.Implementation, "Wire the ComboBox to enum state."),
        new("Review filtered results", WorkKind.Testing, "Confirm each selection shows the expected items."),
        new("Write usage notes", WorkKind.Documentation, "Capture the category behavior for users."),
        new("Polish list cards", WorkKind.Design, "Keep item rows readable with default themed surfaces."),
        new("Compile app", WorkKind.Testing, "Ensure the project builds cleanly.")
    ];

    static readonly string[] FilterLabels = Enum.GetNames<WorkKind>();

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (filter, setFilter) = UseState(WorkKind.All);
        var filteredItems = filter == WorkKind.All
            ? Items
            : Items.Where(item => item.Kind == filter).ToArray();

        return Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Star()],
            TabView(
                [
                    Tab("Work items", WorkItemsTab(filter, setFilter, filteredItems)),
                    Tab("Summary", SummaryTab())
                ])
                .ShowAddButton(false)
                .Grid()
        )
        .Padding(24)
        .Background(Theme.SolidBackground)
        .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default);
    }

    static Element WorkItemsTab(WorkKind filter, Action<WorkKind> setFilter, IReadOnlyList<WorkItem> filteredItems) =>
        Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
            Heading("Work items").Grid(row: 0),
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Px(220), GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto],
                ComboBox(FilterLabels, (int)filter, index => setFilter((WorkKind)index))
                    .AutomationName("Kind filter")
                    .Grid(column: 0),
                Caption($"{filteredItems.Count} item{(filteredItems.Count == 1 ? "" : "s")} shown")
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .VAlign(VerticalAlignment.Center)
                    .Grid(column: 1)
            )
            .Margin(0, 16, 0, 12)
            .Grid(row: 1),
            ListView(
                filteredItems,
                item => item.Title,
                (item, _) => WorkItemRow(item)
            )
            .Grid(row: 2)
        )
        .Padding(16);

    static Element WorkItemRow(WorkItem item) =>
        Border(
            Grid(
                columns: [GridSize.Px(140), GridSize.Star()],
                rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto],
                Caption(item.Kind.ToString())
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 0, rowSpan: 2),
                TextBlock(item.Title)
                    .Grid(row: 0, column: 1),
                Caption(item.Description)
                    .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                    .Grid(row: 1, column: 1)
            )
            .Padding(12)
        )
        .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
        .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke)
        .CornerRadius(8)
        .Margin(0, 0, 0, 8);

    static Element SummaryTab() =>
        Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
            Heading("Summary").Grid(row: 0),
            ListView(
                Enum.GetValues<WorkKind>()
                    .Where(kind => kind != WorkKind.All)
                    .ToArray(),
                kind => kind.ToString(),
                (kind, _) => TextBlock($"{kind}: {Items.Count(item => item.Kind == kind)}")
                    .Padding(8)
            )
            .Margin(0, 16, 0, 0)
            .Grid(row: 1)
        )
        .Padding(16);
}

using Microsoft.UI.Reactor;
using Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core;
using static Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Factories;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Filter List", width: 640, height: 520);

class App : Component
{
    static readonly string[] Items =
    [
        "Apple",
        "Apricot",
        "Banana",
        "Blackberry",
        "Blueberry",
        "Cherry",
        "Coconut",
        "Grape",
        "Kiwi",
        "Lemon",
        "Mango",
        "Orange",
        "Peach",
        "Pear",
        "Pineapple",
        "Plum",
        "Raspberry",
        "Strawberry",
        "Watermelon",
    ];

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (filter, setFilter) = UseState("");
        var filteredItems = Items
            .Where(item => item.Contains(filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .ToArray();

        return Grid(
            columns: ["*"],
            rows: ["Auto", "Auto", "*"],
            Heading("Filter List")
                .Foreground(Theme.PrimaryText)
                .Grid(row: 0),
            TextField(filter, setFilter, placeholder: "Type to filter strings", header: "Filter")
                .Margin(top: 16, bottom: 12)
                .Grid(row: 1),
            Border(
                ScrollView(
                    VStack(8, filteredItems
                        .Select(item =>
                            Border(TextBlock(item).Foreground(Theme.PrimaryText))
                                .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                                .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                                .CornerRadius(8)
                                .Padding(12)
                                .WithKey(item))
                        .ToArray())))
                .Background(Theme.LayerFill)
                .WithBorder(Theme.SurfaceStroke, 1)
                .CornerRadius(8)
                .Padding(12)
                .Grid(row: 2))
            .Background(Theme.SolidBackground)
            .Padding(24);
    }
}

using Microsoft.UI.Reactor;
using Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core;
using static Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Factories;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Tabbed Filter", width: 760, height: 520);

enum FruitFilter
{
    All,
    Citrus,
    Berry,
}

record Fruit(string Name, FruitFilter Category);

class App : Component
{
    static readonly IReadOnlyList<Fruit> Fruits =
    [
        new("Apple", FruitFilter.All),
        new("Orange", FruitFilter.Citrus),
        new("Lemon", FruitFilter.Citrus),
        new("Lime", FruitFilter.Citrus),
        new("Strawberry", FruitFilter.Berry),
        new("Blueberry", FruitFilter.Berry),
        new("Raspberry", FruitFilter.Berry),
    ];

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (filter, setFilter) = UseState(FruitFilter.All);
        var visibleFruit = Fruits
            .Where(fruit => filter == FruitFilter.All || fruit.Category == filter)
            .ToArray();

        return Grid(
            columns: ["*"],
            rows: ["Auto", "*"],
            Heading("Tabbed Filter").Margin(24, 20, 24, 12).Grid(row: 0),
            TabView(
                [
                    Tab("Fruit", FruitTab(filter, setFilter, visibleFruit)),
                    Tab("Summary", SummaryTab(visibleFruit.Length)),
                ])
                .ShowAddButton(false)
                .Margin(24, 0, 24, 24)
                .Grid(row: 1));
    }

    static Element FruitTab(FruitFilter filter, Action<FruitFilter> setFilter, IReadOnlyList<Fruit> visibleFruit) =>
        Grid(
            columns: ["220", "*"],
            rows: ["*"],
            Border(
                VStack(10,
                    SubHeading("Filter"),
                    FilterRadioButton("All fruit", FruitFilter.All, filter, setFilter),
                    FilterRadioButton("Citrus", FruitFilter.Citrus, filter, setFilter),
                    FilterRadioButton("Berry", FruitFilter.Berry, filter, setFilter)))
                .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                .CornerRadius(8)
                .Padding(16)
                .Grid(column: 0),
            Border(
                VStack(8,
                    SubHeading("Results"),
                    ListView<Fruit>(
                        visibleFruit,
                        fruit => fruit.Name,
                        (fruit, _) => TextBlock(fruit.Name).Padding(8))))
                .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                .CornerRadius(8)
                .Padding(16)
                .Grid(column: 1))
            .Margin(12, 0, 0, 0));

    static Element SummaryTab(int visibleCount) =>
        Border(
            VStack(8,
                SubHeading("Current view"),
                TextBlock($"{visibleCount} fruit shown.")))
            .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
            .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
            .CornerRadius(8)
            .Padding(16);

    static Element FilterRadioButton(
        string label,
        FruitFilter value,
        FruitFilter selected,
        Action<FruitFilter> setFilter) =>
        RadioButton(
            label,
            isChecked: selected == value,
            onChecked: isChecked =>
            {
                if (isChecked)
                {
                    setFilter(value);
                }
            },
            groupName: "fruit-filter");
}

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Tabbed Filter", width: 760, height: 520);

enum FruitFilter
{
    All,
    Citrus,
    Berry,
}

record Fruit(string Name, FruitFilter Category);

class App : Component
{
    static readonly IReadOnlyList<Fruit> Fruits =
    [
        new("Apple", FruitFilter.All),
        new("Orange", FruitFilter.Citrus),
        new("Lemon", FruitFilter.Citrus),
        new("Lime", FruitFilter.Citrus),
        new("Strawberry", FruitFilter.Berry),
        new("Blueberry", FruitFilter.Berry),
        new("Raspberry", FruitFilter.Berry),
    ];

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (filter, setFilter) = UseState(FruitFilter.All);
        var visibleFruit = Fruits
            .Where(fruit => filter == FruitFilter.All || fruit.Category == filter)
            .ToArray();

        return Grid(
            columns: ["*"],
            rows: ["Auto", "*"],
            Heading("Tabbed Filter").Margin(24, 20, 24, 12).Grid(row: 0),
            TabView(
                [
                    Tab("Fruit", FruitTab(filter, setFilter, visibleFruit)),
                    Tab("Summary", SummaryTab(visibleFruit.Length)),
                ])
                .ShowAddButton(false)
                .Margin(24, 0, 24, 24)
                .Grid(row: 1));
    }

    static Element FruitTab(FruitFilter filter, Action<FruitFilter> setFilter, IReadOnlyList<Fruit> visibleFruit) =>
        Grid(
            columns: ["220", "*"],
            rows: ["*"],
            Border(
                VStack(10,
                    SubHeading("Filter"),
                    FilterRadioButton("All fruit", FruitFilter.All, filter, setFilter),
                    FilterRadioButton("Citrus", FruitFilter.Citrus, filter, setFilter),
                    FilterRadioButton("Berry", FruitFilter.Berry, filter, setFilter)))
                .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                .CornerRadius(8)
                .Padding(16)
                .Grid(column: 0),
            Border(
                VStack(8,
                    SubHeading("Results"),
                    ListView<Fruit>(
                        visibleFruit,
                        fruit => fruit.Name,
                        (fruit, _) => TextBlock(fruit.Name).Padding(8))))
                .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                .CornerRadius(8)
                .Padding(16)
                .Grid(column: 1))
            .Margin(12, 0, 0, 0));

    static Element SummaryTab(int visibleCount) =>
        Border(
            VStack(8,
                SubHeading("Current view"),
                TextBlock($"{visibleCount} fruit shown.")))
            .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
            .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
            .CornerRadius(8)
            .Padding(16);

    static Element FilterRadioButton(
        string label,
        FruitFilter value,
        FruitFilter selected,
        Action<FruitFilter> setFilter) =>
        RadioButton(
            label,
            isChecked: selected == value,
            onChecked: isChecked =>
            {
                if (isChecked)
                {
                    setFilter(value);
                }
            },
            groupName: "fruit-filter");
}

        "Date",

    ];

using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using static Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Factories;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Dialog Filter Flow", width: 720, height: 520);

class App : Component
{
    static readonly string[] Items =
    [
        "Apple",
        "Apricot",
        "Banana",
        "Blueberry",
        "Cherry",
        "Clementine",
        "Date",
        "Grape"
    ];

    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (isDialogOpen, setDialogOpen) = UseState(false);
        var (filterText, setFilterText) = UseState("ap");
        var (filterEnabled, setFilterEnabled) = UseState(false);

        var visibleItems = UseMemo(
            () => filterEnabled
                ? Items.Where(item => item.Contains(filterText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToArray()
                : Items,
            filterEnabled,
            filterText);

        return Grid(
            columns: [GridSize.Star()],
            rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Star()],
            children:
            [
                VStack(4,
                    Heading("Dialog filter flow"),
                    Caption("Open the dialog, switch filtering on, and edit the string filter.")
                        .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                ).Grid(row: 0),

                Border(
                    Grid(
                        columns: [GridSize.Star(), GridSize.Auto],
                        rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto],
                        children:
                        [
                            TextBlock(filterEnabled
                                    ? $"Showing items containing \"{filterText}\""
                                    : "Showing all strings")
                                .Foreground(Theme.PrimaryText)
                                .Grid(row: 0, column: 0),

                            Button("Filter...", () => setDialogOpen(true))
                                .Grid(row: 0, column: 1),

                            Caption($"{visibleItems.Length} of {Items.Length} strings")
                                .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                                .Grid(row: 1, column: 0, columnSpan: 2)
                        ]
                    )
                )
                    .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                    .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Grid(row: 1),

                Border(
                    ScrollView(
                        VStack(8, visibleItems
                            .Select(item =>
                                Border(TextBlock(item).Foreground(Theme.PrimaryText))
                                    .Background(Theme.SubtleFill)
                                    .CornerRadius(6)
                                    .Padding(10)
                                    .WithKey(item))
                            .ToArray())
                    )
                )
                    .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                    .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Grid(row: 2),

                ContentDialog(
                    "Filter strings",
                    Grid(
                        columns: [GridSize.Star()],
                        rows: [GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto, GridSize.Auto],
                        children:
                        [
                            ToggleSwitch(
                                    filterEnabled,
                                    setFilterEnabled,
                                    onContent: "Filtering on",
                                    offContent: "Filtering off",
                                    header: "Use string filter")
                                .Grid(row: 0),

                            TextField(
                                    filterText,
                                    setFilterText,
                                    placeholder: "Type part of a string",
                                    header: "Filter text")
                                .Grid(row: 1),

                            Caption(filterEnabled
                                    ? $"{visibleItems.Length} matching strings"
                                    : "Toggle filtering on to narrow the list.")
                                .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText)
                                .Grid(row: 2)
                        ]
                    ),
                    primaryButtonText: "Done") with
                {
                    IsOpen = isDialogOpen,
                    OnClosed = _ => setDialogOpen(false),
                }
            ]
        ).Padding(24);
    }
}

using Microsoft.UI.Reactor;
using Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using static Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Factories;

ReactorApp.Run<App>("Tabbed Record Editor", width: 720, height: 480);

record EditableRecord(string Text);

class App : Component
{
    public override Element Render()
    {
        var (record, setRecord) = UseState(new EditableRecord("Edit this record text."));

        return Grid(
            columns: ["*"],
            rows: ["*"],
            children:
            [
                TabView(
                [
                    Tab("Edit", RenderEditor(record, text => setRecord(record with { Text = text }))),
                    Tab("Preview", RenderPreview(record))
                ]).ShowAddButton(false)
                  .Grid(0, 0)
            ])
            .Padding(24)
            .RequestedTheme(ElementTheme.Default);
    }

    private static Element RenderEditor(EditableRecord record, Action<string> setText) =>
        Grid(
            columns: ["*"],
            rows: ["Auto", "Auto", "*"],
            children:
            [
                Heading("Record editor")
                    .Grid(0, 0),

                TextField(record.Text, setText, placeholder: "Record text", header: "TextBox")
                    .AcceptsReturn()
                    .TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap)
                    .Grid(1, 0)
                    .Margin(top: 16),

                Border(
                    TextBlock($"Current value: {record.Text}")
                        .TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap)
                        .Foreground(Theme.SecondaryText))
                    .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                    .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Grid(2, 0)
                    .Margin(top: 16)
            ]);

    private static Element RenderPreview(EditableRecord record) =>
        Grid(
            columns: ["*"],
            rows: ["Auto", "*"],
            children:
            [
                Heading("Preview")
                    .Grid(0, 0),

                Border(
                    TextBlock(record.Text)
                        .TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap))
                    .Background(Theme.CardBackground)
                    .WithBorder(Theme.CardStroke, 1)
                    .CornerRadius(8)
                    .Padding(16)
                    .Grid(1, 0)
                    .Margin(top: 16)
            ]);
}
